CHALLENGE 009 — TOOL QUICKSTART
THE SEALED HANDOVER / METADATA + APPENDED ZIP

Kali Linux / Ubuntu / WSL2
--------------------------
1. Identify the image and inspect its metadata:
   file archive_photo.jpg
   exiftool -UserComment archive_photo.jpg
2. Decode the UserComment value (replace VALUE with the actual metadata text):
   printf '%s' 'VALUE' | base64 -d
   This output is the archive password, not the final flag.
3. Identify the appended ZIP:
   binwalk archive_photo.jpg
4. Try direct extraction with the recovered password:
   unzip -P 'RECOVERED_PASSWORD' archive_photo.jpg
   Some Info-ZIP versions warn that non-ZIP bytes precede the archive. If direct extraction
   fails, use the ZIP offset reported by Binwalk to carve the ZIP segment, then:
   unzip -P 'RECOVERED_PASSWORD' carved_payload.zip
5. Read `handover_note.txt`.

Windows
-------
Use WSL2/Kali with the commands above, or combine:
- ExifTool for Windows: https://exiftool.org/
- 7-Zip: https://www.7-zip.org/
If the archive is appended to the JPEG, first carve the ZIP segment using a file-offset
tool, then open the carved ZIP with 7-Zip and enter the Base64-decoded password.

The case evidence is local. Internet-based EXIF and Base64 tools are optional.
